functions.name: PropagateParentClassFlags_CompileClassLayout
functions.docs: Utility functions for ClassFlags that is reused between normal and skeleton-only compilation.

functions.name: PropagateParentClassFlags_FinishCompilingClass
functions.docs: Given a class, let it inherit class flags from its parent class. Only considers inheritable flags.

functions.name: AppendPropertyBasedClassFlags
functions.docs: Given a class, set any class flags that are based on its properties. Does not consider parent class properties.
